WPMS No. 3336 of 2025
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Aakash Dar Dubey (through V.C.) with Mr. 
Shiv Pandey, learned counsel for the Petitioner. 
2. Mr. Manoj Kumar, learned counsel holding brief 
of Ms. Pushpa Bhatt, learned S.C.G.C. for the 
Respondent no.2. 
3. The present writ petition under Articles 226/227
of the Constitution of India is filed by the Petitioner to
quash the order dated 18.04.2022 of the Deputy Chief 
Labour Commissioner (Central), Dehradun and further 
to direct the Respondents herein to reinstate the 
Petitioner with full back wages from the date of illegal 
dismissal i.e. 31.03.2016 as well as to regularize the 
appointment of the Petitioner with effect from the year 
of his joining i.e. 1989. 
4. As per office report dated 10.12.2025, in 
compliance of the previous order passed by the 
Coordinate Bench Vakalatnama has been filed by Mr. 
Aakash Dar Dubey, Advocate on behalf of the 
Petitioner. 
5. Heard.
6. Admit. 
7. Issue notice to the Respondent no.1, returnable 
within two weeks. Steps to be taken within one week. 8. Objections, if any, to be filed by the 
Respondents by the next date of listing.
9. List this matter on 07.01.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 11.12.2025
